title: A missing bracket
prompt: The robot should print "Hello", but the code will not run. Press Run, read the error, and fix the one thing wrong on that line.
hints: Every opening bracket needs a closing one.
The error says what it expected and on which line.
Add the missing ) at the end of the print line.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
